sin.name: command-file-loose-in-commands
sin.description: A class sits directly in a commands folder instead of in the folder of its command or in the support folder.
sin.rule: Each command has a folder of its own in its module: commands/<name>/<name>.py, <name>_handler.py and <name>_subcommand.py; a helper goes in commands/support/ or beside the one command it serves.
